description: Full OpenRouter model catalog (all models, dispatchable via openrouter). Complements the hand-verified tiered registry in policy.json. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, live-verified at fetched_at. Tier is NOT assigned here — tiering of the 20 canonical models lives in policy.json; this file makes every OpenRouter model dispatchable so any of them can fill a node.

dispatch.invoke: hermes chat -p <profile> -m openrouter/<model_id>   # or pin --provider openrouter --model <model_id> on a dispatched card
dispatch.note: model_id is the full 'provider/slug' string exactly as OpenRouter lists it.
